resources.string: Injects an OpenXR implicit API layer that streams PICO full-body tracking (XR_BD_body_tracking) and physical object tracker poses (XR_BD_motion_tracking) to the companion SteamVR OpenVR driver over UDP
IPv4 address of the PC running SteamVR and the Seamless PICO Motion Tracker driver. Leave blank to auto-discover on the local network
UDP port the SteamVR OpenVR driver listens on (default 39575).
Selects active SteamVR tracker roles in full-body mode: 3pt (Waist, Feet), 6pt (+ Chest, Knees), 8pt (+ Elbows), 10pt (+ Shoulders), or all (+ Hips, Wrists)
auto follows the headset PICO Motion Tracker setting (Body or Object tracking); body forces full-body joints; object forces raw physical tracker poses
